stories.headline: Another SOUTHCOM strike on an eastern Pacific speedboat kills five as the campaign passes 70 strikes
stories.body: On 27 October, US Southern Command struck a go-fast boat on what it called established trafficking routes in the eastern Pacific, killing all five aboard; no drugs were recovered or weighed. Stars and Stripes puts the roughly year-old campaign at more than 70 strikes and at least 230 dead, though other outlets have cited higher death counts. The campaign remains legally contested: a UN investigator said in September there were grounds to view the strikes as possible crimes against humanity.
